# Papercuts — akr

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-08-09 [codex] Writing several evidence and lifecycle records repeated full Git-history work and a post-write session reload, turning small ledger mutations into minute-scale operations. Batch Git facts by ledger file, avoid the redundant reload, and provide atomic bulk evidence.  `@akr.papercut.writing-several-evidence-and-lifecycle-records/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] The CLI help advertises --edit for propose and revise, but this build rejects it as unavailable; the documented path caused an avoidable failed write before falling back to --from.  `@akr.papercut.the-cli-help-advertises-edit-for-propose-and/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] Strict clippy for the new GUI crate promoted more than 200 existing missing-docs warnings from the in-progress ingest APIs and obscured the one GUI lint. A target-scoped lint profile or temporary ingest-specific allowance would keep unrelated dependency warnings from swamping focused checks.  `@akr.papercut.strict-clippy-for-the-new-gui-crate-promoted/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] Revising a sealed record through the supported knowledge.revise path changes its old revision to superseded and causes knowledge.validate to report AKR-R051 until rebuild, while ops documentation says lifecycle writes should produce AKR-R052. This makes an authorized lifecycle transition look like sealed-content tampering; distinguish it or document the exact rebuild boundary.  `@akr.papercut.revising-a-sealed-record-through-the-supported/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] knowledge.search detects a stale index but continues serving it, so agents repeatedly receive known-old planning results until a human runs `akr build`. Search should safely refresh or fall back to current source data before returning results.  `@akr.papercut.knowledge-search-detects-a-stale-index-but/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] I tried , assuming get supported a source rendering mode; --format is only the global text/json selector. The get help could make raw-record inspection guidance explicit for agents closing acceptance checks.  `@akr.papercut.i-tried-assuming-get-supported-a-source/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] Completing a milestone failed because a downstream depends_on edge treated completed work like abandonment, forcing agents to remove the satisfied dependency and manufacture lifecycle revisions. Completion should satisfy depends_on while preserving the edge as provenance.  `@akr.papercut.completing-a-milestone-failed-because-a/1`
